entities.name: Kasbah Mosque in Tangier
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Kasbah Mosque is a mosque in Tangier, Morocco, and the main mosque of the historic royal citadel (kasbah) in the old city (medina) of Tangier. It dates to the late 17th century.
